title: Transcribe voice through the bundled cometix-asr addon
description:
Replaces the WebSocket voice transport with the cometix-asr addon, so audio is transcribed on the machine instead of streamed to Anthropic. The addon is loaded from vendor/cometix-asr beside the entry; when it is absent the patch reports a load error rather than silently falling back, since the stock path would send the audio off-box.

Audio is signed 16-bit little-endian PCM at 16 kHz mono — what the host already captures, and what feedPcm expects.

sites.description: The adapter, inserted ahead of the connector it stands in for. Self-contained rather than imported: the chunk it lands in is chosen by content, so its path is not something the patch can name.

Divert to the local adapter before the connector touches credentials — a refresh here would prompt for a login that local transcription has no use for. CLAUDE_CODE_ASR=0 restores the stock WebSocket path.

The host awaits this function and only checks that it resolved to something, so returning a different transport is transparent to it.
